trail.notes: 8 stages, The Peak to Big Wave Bay, through 5 country parks on Hong Kong Island. Distance posts H001–H100 every 500 m; H001 is on Lugard Road ~0.4 km from the start, H100 at Big Wave Bay. H068 and H084 stand at stage boundaries and appear in two stages. Post ranges checked against AFCD post grid references and AFCD GPX tracks. In an emergency call 999 and give the nearest post number. Times, lengths and difficulty are from AFCD Enjoy Hiking (hiking.gov.hk); non-summit high points are approximate, from AFCD GPX. Bus/minibus details checked against Citybus and GMB open data on 2026-09-26; always check before travel.
trail.notes_zh: 全長50公里，分8段，由山頂至大浪灣，途經港島五個郊野公園。標距柱H001至H100每500米一支；H001位於盧吉道距起點約0.4公里，H100在大浪灣。H068及H084位於段與段交界。遇緊急情況請致電999並報告最近的標距柱編號。時間、長度及難度取自漁護署「郊野樂行」。交通資料於2026年9月26日核對，出發前請再查閱。

香港仔上水塘水壩、水掣房及石橋（法定古蹟）

stages.safety_zh: 有約700米持續上斜，注意防曬及補充水分（漁護署）。

Mount Butler viewpoint over Tai Tam reservoirs
Osborn memorial (1941 battle)

stages.safety_en: Big climbs and descents; needs fitness. Little shade. Steep stairs (about 600 steps) down to Quarry Gap. No water on the ridge.
stages.safety_zh: 上落差大，需一定體能。遮蔭少。落大風坳有約600級陡梯。山上無水源補給。

highlights_en: Shady 'air-con corridor' of tall trees
Tai Tam Upper Reservoir and century-old dams
1850s milestone of the old Stanley–Victoria road
highlights_zh: 高大樹木形成的天然「冷氣走廊」
大潭上水塘及百年水壩
1850年代群帶路里程碑
stages.water_en: No supply on the trail. AFCD water station at Tai Tam Tuk Reservoir is temporarily closed.
stages.water_zh: 沿途無補給。大潭篤水塘漁護署加水站暫停開放。

exits_zh: 分支往大潭峽
大潭上水塘水壩後：沿大潭水塘道北往陽明山莊／黃泥涌峽

from_end.note_zh: 先向大潭港方向步行約1公里（漁護署）。往嘉亨灣（西灣河）或赤柱。

from_end.from_en: Tai Tam Road, Tai Tam Dam (North)
from_end.from_zh: 大潭道大潭水塘大壩北面
from_end.note_en: To Chai Wan Station, or toward Stanley / Chung Hom Kok.

stages.safety_en: Tai Tam Road near the exit has no pavement in places; it is narrow and busy. Take care walking to the bus stop.
stages.safety_zh: 出口大潭道部分路段無行人路，狹窄繁忙，前往車站時須小心。

to_start.from_en: Shau Kei Wan Bus Terminus (MTR Shau Kei Wan, Exit A)
to_start.from_zh: 筲箕灣巴士總站（港鐵筲箕灣站A出口）
to_start.note_en: Citybus toward Shek O; alight To Tei Wan. Trailhead is beside the stop.
to_start.note_zh: 城巴往石澳，於「土地灣」站下車，起點在車站旁。

to_start.from_en: Near MTR Shau Kei Wan (Perfect Mount Gardens terminus)
to_start.from_zh: 筲箕灣港鐵站附近（峻峰花園小巴站）
to_start.note_en: Red minibus; tell the driver 'To Tei Wan' (土地灣).
to_start.note_zh: 紅色小巴，上車告知司機在土地灣落車。

from_end.route: Big Wave Bay – Shau Kei Wan
from_end.from_en: Big Wave Bay
from_end.note_en: Red minibus starts at Big Wave Bay; runs about 09:30–22:50 (Sun/PH from 08:30). Leaves when full; carry cash.
from_end.note_zh: 紅色小巴由大浪灣開出，約09:30至22:50（週日及假期08:30起），滿座即開，請備現金。

from_end.from_en: Big Wave Bay Road / Shek O Road
from_end.note_en: Only a few trips call at Big Wave Bay itself; otherwise walk ~1 km up Big Wave Bay Road to Shek O Road and take Citybus 9 to Shau Kei Wan MTR.
from_end.note_zh: 只有少數班次進入大浪灣站；一般需沿大浪灣道步行約1公里至石澳道，乘城巴9號往筲箕灣港鐵站。

stages.safety_en: Exposed ridge with little shade: heat and sun risk in summer. Steep climb for the first ~1.5 km. Very crowded on weekends. Parts are shared with mountain bikes.
stages.safety_zh: 山脊開揚少遮蔭，夏天慎防中暑及曬傷。首約1.5公里上斜。週末人多。部分路段與越野單車共用。
